card.name: Have or with after patients
card.fires_on: The small words "have", "has", "with" or "about" right after a patient or patients subject, where a medical condition or history is about to be named. Seen in warnings and precautions text.

modes.label: have/has after patients
modes.description: The verb have or has follows patients (who/may/if) and leads into a condition or risk.
modes.example: sudden death in patients who<< have>> heart problems or heart defects

modes.label: with after patients
modes.description: The word with follows patients and introduces a known disease or risk factor.

modes.description: The word about follows careful inquiry before a list of past reactions.
